title: How I Met Your Mother - Screams and Dreams (Edit)
description:
Edit of the famous "Look around Ted, You're all alone." scene, from How I Met Your Mother (S8E20), swapping the original OST with "Screams and Dreams" by Faye, which fits extremely well.

Most notably, the instrumental part during the climax of the scene, where Ted runs to Tracy in his imagination, comes directly from the song, looking as if it was written specifically for this scene.

Song: Faye - Screams and Dreams.
